{"id":1593747584,"question_id":3154,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743553144,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1593747584/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet I","memory":"21.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        long long max_val = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n-2 ;i++)\n        {\n            for(int j=i+1 ; j<n-1 ;j++)\n            {\n                for(int k = j+1 ; k<n ; k++)\n                {\n                    long long val = (long long)(nums[i]-nums[j]) * nums[k];\n                    max_val = max(max_val , val);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return max_val;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-an-ordered-triplet-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":526}
